expect.name: Gemstone Mimicry
expect.cite: table rule hide_attacks_that_can_do_nothing (on): Gemstone Mimicry ('Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Tera Pokemon's attacks and use it as this attack') has no attack to choose when the opponent's Active Pokemon isn't a Tera Pokemon (a Benched one doesn't count); off it is (APR A-01: an attack needs its Energy)
